info.title: clrkernel-studio — notebook job runner for ClrKernel (preview).
info.description: Preview: notebook job scheduler for ClrKernel. Runs .nb.md/.ipynb/.dib notebooks as jobs — scheduled (cron), manual, or DAG-chained — with per-cell progress, run history, and a web dashboard. Each run executes in an isolated `clrkernel serve` process.

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Turn the notebooks root into a test/prod git workspace
(adopts existing notebooks into test and promotes them).

options.name: --notebooks
options.description:
Notebooks root (default: current directory,
or CLRKERNEL_STUDIO_NOTEBOOKS).

options.name: --data-dir
options.description:
Data directory (default: ~/.clrkernel/jobs,
or CLRKERNEL_STUDIO_DATA).

options.name: --clrkernel
options.description:
Path to the clrkernel executable (default:
PATH, then ~/.dotnet/tools).

options.name: --store
--connection-string
options.description: Connection string for sqlserver/postgres.

options.name: --urls
options.description:
serve: listen address
(default http://localhost:5000).

options.name: --rp-id
options.description:
serve: the domain passkeys are bound to
(or CLRKERNEL_STUDIO_RPID). Default localhost.

options.name: --origins
options.description:
serve: origins the browser may present
(or CLRKERNEL_STUDIO_ORIGINS). Default: --urls.

options.name: --max-parallelism
options.description: serve: concurrent runs (default 4).

options.name: --git
options.description:
Enable the test/prod git workflow
(or CLRKERNEL_STUDIO_GIT).

options.name: --env
options.description: run: which environment (default test).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the jobs found under the notebooks root.

commands.name: run
commands.description:
Run one job now and print per-cell progress.
With the git workflow: --env test (default) or prod.

commands.name: serve
commands.description:
Run the scheduler: cron jobs fire on time, dependent jobs
fire when everything they need has freshly succeeded.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Parse and validate every *.jobs.yaml; exit 1 on problems.
